name: com.gamecraftlab.unifiedinventorysystem
description:
One grid inventory engine for every style: one-cell-per-item (Skyrim-like), rectangular multi-cell items with rotation (Resident Evil 4), and irregular items in irregular containers with cell states such as damage (Dredge).

▪ Pure C# core (InventoryGrid, CellShape, InventorySystem) — fully unit-tested, no MonoBehaviour required
▪ Pluggable placement rules (IPlacementValidator, CellStateManager + strategies)
▪ Stacking, auto-placement, transfers between containers
▪ JSON save/load with an item database
▪ uGUI views with mouse drag & drop and gamepad cursor
▪ Editor tools: shape painter, container painter, database builder, CSV/JSON importer

samples.description: Basic, RE4-style and Dredge-style inventories side by side, built entirely from code. Add BasicDemo to an empty scene and press Play.
